_sprog._note: Keys missing here fall back to Danish, which is the source language.

topbar.hjaelp: Press record when the meeting starts. You name it afterwards — and you can write notes as you go.
topbar.beskeder: Notifications about what the app has finished
topbar.vaelgsprog: Change the language of the app
topbar.diktering_hold_tip: Hold the key down, speak, and let go. The text is written out and placed where the cursor is. Switch it off under Dictation.

cockpit.under: HeyPia is your personal information assistant. Everything you work with in the app — what was said in your meetings, the notes you took along the way, and the documents that came out of it — is gathered here and can be found in an instant.
cockpit.tomtekst: Searches all transcripts, the notes you wrote during the meeting, and documents the app has made. More words means they must all appear close together.
cockpit.tomfod: The files are read on your machine. Nothing is sent.

kalender.hentaftalerhjaelp: Fetch the events from Google now. They are also fetched automatically every fifteen minutes

opgaver.hentopgaverhjaelp: Fetch the tasks from Google Tasks now. They are also fetched automatically every fifteen minutes

faelles.ny_mappe_til_fx_en_kunde_eller_et_projek: New folder — for a client or a project, say

mainwindow.api_noeglen_til_den_europaeiske_sprogmod: The API key for the European language model is not set up yet. Without it the app can record and transcribe, but not produce documents. Click here for the instructions.
mainwindow.tilbage_til_listen_over_steder: Back to the list of places

meetingview.optag_et_webinar_kun_det_du_hoerer_halv_: Record a webinar — only what you hear. Half the size, half the time, and it stops on its own.
meetingview.skriv_en_note_her_og_tryk_enter_den_bliv: Write a note here and press Enter — it gets a timestamp
meetingview.skriv_en_note_og_tryk_enter_den_bliver_t: Write a note and press Enter. It gets a timestamp, so it can be merged into the transcript in the right place. Ctrl+B sets a bookmark without text.

searchview.der_er_ingen_aabne_opgaver_de_kommer_fra: There are no open tasks. They come from the «Tasks» tab on a recording that has been transcribed — there the app suggests them from what was said, and you choose which ones become real.
searchview.gaa_til_det_sted_i_transkriptionen_opgav: Go to the place in the transcript the task came from
searchview.gaa_til_dette_sted_i_teksten: Go to this place in the text
searchview.husk_at_et_moede_foerst_kan_soeges_naar_: Remember that a meeting can only be searched once it has been transcribed — a recording on its own holds no words to look through.
searchview.ingen_aftaler_i_kalenderen_opret_en_her_: No events in the calendar. Create one here — or connect Google Calendar under Settings, and they will be fetched for you.
searchview.kun_optagelser_af_denne_moedetype: Only recordings of this meeting type
searchview.saet_flueben_naar_den_er_gjort: Tick it when it is done

optagebaand.afslut_optagelsen_og_gem_den_du_navngive: End the recording and save it. You name the meeting afterwards.
optagebaand.hold_pause_der_optages_intet_foer_du_for: Pause. Nothing is recorded until you resume.
optagebaand.kasser_optagelsen_uden_at_gemme_lyden_bl: Discard the recording without saving. The audio is deleted.
optagebaand.skriv_en_note_og_tryk_enter_den_bliver_t: Write a note and press Enter. It gets a timestamp.
optagebaand.vis_hele_appen_frem_optagelsen_fortsaett: Bring the whole app forward. The recording continues, and the bar stays.

meetingliveview.ingen_noter_endnu_skriv_det_der_skal_hus: No notes yet. Write down what needs remembering — a decision, a number, a task — and press Enter. The note takes the time it was written, so it can be merged into the transcript in the right place afterwards.
meetingliveview.skriv_en_note_og_tryk_enter_ctrl_b_saett: Write a note and press Enter · Ctrl+B sets a bookmark without text

moedevagtpopup.luk_der_spoerges_igen_naeste_gang_et_moe: Close. You will be asked again the next time a meeting starts.
moedevagtpopup.sig_til_de_andre_at_du_optager_lyden_bli: Tell the others you are recording. The audio stays on your machine, so it is easy to explain.
moedevagtpopup.skal_moedet_optages_appen_optager_aldrig: Record this meeting? The app never records on its own — only what you press happens.

opstartwindow.link_til_webinaret_kan_staa_tomt: LINK TO THE WEBINAR (may be left empty)
opstartwindow.opret_en_ny_mappe_uden_at_forlade_dialog: Create a new folder without leaving the dialogue
opstartwindow.optagelsen_stopper_af_sig_selv_efter_fem: The recording stops on its own after five minutes of silence, and the silence is trimmed off. You do not have to stay at the machine.
opstartwindow.vil_du_slippe_for_at_hoere_med_saa_skru_: If you would rather not listen along, turn down the Windows volume by the clock — it still records. But do not mute inside the webinar itself; then no sound is played, and there is nothing to record.

correctionwindow.den_oprindelige_udskrift_gemmes_ved_side: The original transcript is kept alongside as .raa.txt, so a correction can always be undone.
correctionwindow.rettelsen_bliver_en_regel_naeste_gang_de: The correction becomes a rule. The next time the same thing is misheard, the app fixes it itself — in this transcript and in every future one.

historyview.alt_appen_har_gjort_hvornaar_med_hvilken: Everything the app has done, when, with which model — and how it went.
historyview.der_er_ikke_sket_noget_endnu_historikken: Nothing has happened yet. The history fills up as you record meetings, transcribe them and produce documents.
historyview.gaa_til_den_linjen_handler_om: Go to the one the line is about

sprogvalgwindow.de_oevrige_moededeltagere_som_de_loed_i_: The other participants, as they sounded through the speaker. They do not have to speak the same language as you.
sprogvalgwindow.dig_og_alle_andre_i_det_samme_lokale: You and everyone else in the same room.
sprogvalgwindow.vaelg_find_selv_kun_hvis_du_virkelig_ikk: Choose «detect it» only if you genuinely do not know. If the guess is wrong, the whole transcript comes out in the wrong language — and the result looks like finished text, so the mistake is only spotted in the minutes.

setupwindow.lyden_bliver_her_teksten_bliver_i_europa: The audio stays here. The text is only sent if you ask for it.
setupwindow.heypia_optager_dine_moeder_og_skriver_de: HeyPia records your meetings and transcribes them here on your machine. If minutes or another document are to be made from the text, that happens at Mistral AI in France — and only the text is sent.
setupwindow.optagelsen_kan_ikke_sendes_nogen_steder_: The recording cannot be sent anywhere. The app has no code that could — only the finished text can be sent, and only to the European endpoint. You set that up yourself in a moment, and you may leave it be.
setupwindow.optagelser_transkriptioner_noter_og_doku: Recordings, transcripts, notes and documents. Choose another folder if you want them on an encrypted disk, for instance.
setupwindow.selve_transskriptionen_laves_af_whisper_: The transcription itself is done by Whisper, which runs locally. Your meeting audio files never leave the machine — not even when a document is made. The engine and the model must be downloaded once, and you are asked first.
setupwindow.transskriptionen_laves_af_whisper_som_ko: The transcription is done by Whisper, which runs on your own machine. The engine and a language model must be downloaded once. The download only pulls down — nothing is sent from your PC along the way.
setupwindow.lyd_under: The microphone is used for your own words — both when recording a meeting and when dictating. If you do not choose one here, the app takes the one Windows points at for SPEECH — which is not always the same as the Windows default device. The two are set in different places. Choose yours here and you need not think about it.
setupwindow.hoejttaler_under: The speaker is recorded as a second track, so the others in the meeting make it into the transcript. Nothing is played through it.
setupwindow.klar_under: The shortcut can only start a recording while the app is running. That is why the two belong together.
setupwindow.autostart: Start HeyPia when I sign in to Windows
setupwindow.autostart_under: The app does not open a window at startup — it sits ready until you press the shortcut. It takes up nothing while not recording.
setupwindow.vaageord_under: Then a dictation can be started without touching the keyboard. Say «Hej Pia» and carry on speaking — the text lands where the cursor is.
setupwindow.vaageord_privatliv: The listening happens on your own PC. Nothing is sent while it listens — neither audio nor text. What the microphone hears exists only in memory until it is decided whether the word was said. No audio file is written and no log is kept. If the screen is locked, or a recording is running, it does not listen.
setupwindow.kan_altid_aendres: Everything here can be changed later under Settings — and the whole flow can be run again from the same place.
setupwindow.navn_under: Used when a dictation is turned into an email, so it can be signed. Leave it empty and no signature is written.

opgavewindow.det_der_staar_paa_listen_i_cockpittet_ho: What appears in the list in the Cockpit. Keep it short — the rest belongs below.
opgavewindow.hvilken_liste: Which of your Google Tasks lists the task ends up in
opgavewindow.ny_under: It goes into the Cockpit along with your other tasks
opgavewindow.rettelser_sendes_op: Changes made here are sent up to Google, and what is changed in Google comes down at the next fetch. Priority is HeyPia's own field and stays here.
opgavewindow.saet_hakket_hvis_ogsaa_i_google: Tick the box if the task should also be in Google Tasks — then it is on your phone too. Without the tick it stays here.

newdocumentwindow.beskrivelse_valgfri_staar_oeverst_i_doku: Description (optional — appears at the top of the document)
newdocumentwindow.moedetypen_bestemmer_hvilke_afsnit_dokum: The meeting type decides which sections the document gets, and how long it becomes.
newdocumentwindow.vil_du_have_et_komplet_word_dokument: Would you like a complete Word document?

skysetupwindow.det_skal_du_selv_soerge_for: This you must see to yourself
skysetupwindow.hentes_paa_console_mistral_ai_under_api_: Found at console.mistral.ai under API Keys. It is stored in your data folder — never in the program, and never anywhere it could travel with an update.
skysetupwindow.hvem_roerer_data_undervejs: Who touches the data along the way
skysetupwindow.jeg_har_slaaet_fra_paa_min_mistral_konto: I have turned off, on my Mistral account, that my data may be used for training.
skysetupwindow.mistral_er_fransk_og_hoster_i_europa_men: Mistral is French and hosts in Europe, but uses sub-processors — among them Microsoft (Sweden and Norway) and CoreWeave (EEA). They are American-owned, even when the servers stand in Europe. If you want to be able to say «no American company is involved», that does not hold. If you want to say «the processing happens in Europe, with a European supplier, under a data processing agreement», that holds. The full list is at trust.mistral.ai.
skysetupwindow.mistral_har_ogsaa_et_globalt_endepunkt_h: Mistral also has a global endpoint, where they promise no particular geography. The app does not use it, and it cannot be switched on. The European one costs 10 % more — around two øre per set of minutes.
skysetupwindow.mistrals_aftale_tillader_at_dine_data_br: Mistral's agreement allows your data to be used to train their models — UNLESS you turn it off yourself. It is a setting on your account, not something that follows the subscription, and the app cannot set it for you.
skysetupwindow.optagelse_og_transskription_bliver_paa_d: Recording and transcription stay on your PC no matter what. This is only about the minutes themselves — the text can be sent to a European supplier, which writes them faster and more fully than the model on the machine.
skysetupwindow.saadan_log_ind_paa_console_mistral_ai_wo: How: log in at console.mistral.ai → Workspace → Data → turn off that input and output may be used for training. Take a screenshot — the setting can change with a new workspace or a new key, without you being told.

nytemplatewindow.det_afgoer_baade_laengden_og_sproget_en_: It decides both the length and the language. A client, a steering group and a developer should not get the same thing.
nytemplatewindow.et_pr_linje_fx_beslutninger_med_begrunde: One per line. For instance «decisions with reasoning», «what it costs», «who follows up and when», «open questions».
nytemplatewindow.fx_beslutningsnotat_kundemoede_eller_tek: For instance «Decision note», «Client meeting» or «Technical review».
nytemplatewindow.hvad_skal_der_komme_ud_af_det: What should come out of it?
nytemplatewindow.hvad_skal_dokumentet_hedde: What should the document be called?
nytemplatewindow.hvem_skal_laese_det: Who is going to read it?
nytemplatewindow.laengden_er_en_beslutning_ikke_et_tilfae: The length is a decision, not an accident. A note nobody can face reading does not get read — and one that is too short loses what was needed.
nytemplatewindow.moedetypen_skrives_af_mistral_den_skal_s: The meeting type is written by Mistral. That must be set up first
nytemplatewindow.reglerne_for_hvem_der_kommer_paa_deltage: The rules for who ends up on the participant list are added as a shared field — they are the same for every meeting type. So is the requirement to write in Danish and never invent figures, names or dates that are not in the transcript.
nytemplatewindow.skriv_det_som_du_ville_forklare_en_kolle: Write it as you would explain it to a colleague. «A short note for management with the decisions that were made, and what they cost.»
nytemplatewindow.svar_paa_det_du_kender_hvad_dokumentet_s: Answer what you know — what the document is for, and who reads it. Then Mistral writes the meeting type, and you correct it afterwards.

aftalewindow.aabner_moedelinket_i_din_browser: Opens the meeting link in your browser
aftalewindow.aftalen_aabnes_i_google_kalender_naar_de: The event opens in Google Calendar once it has been created. Your contacts and the invitations belong there — not here.
aftalewindow.de_her_tre_foelger_med_saa_der_ikke_skal: These three come along, so nothing has to be answered while the meeting is starting. Left empty, you are asked as usual.
aftalewindow.du_er_selv_arrangoer_saa_er_det_dig_der_: You are the organiser yourself. Then it is up to you to tell the participants if the meeting is being recorded.
aftalewindow.link_eller_sted_kan_staa_tomt: LINK OR PLACE (may be left empty)
aftalewindow.linket_kommer_med_tilbage_saa_moedet_kan: The link comes back with it, so the meeting can be started from here. If you also tick «Start the recording automatically», a note travels with the invitation: that meeting transcription is used, that it requires the AUDIO to be recorded, that no video is recorded, that the audio stays on your computer — and that anyone may object. The wording can be edited under Settings → Integrations, in Danish and English.
aftalewindow.naar_du_trykker_optag_paa_aftalen: When you press record on the event
aftalewindow.opret_ogsaa_i_google_kalender: Create in Google Calendar as well
aftalewindow.opretter_et_moedelokale_hos_google_og_la: Creates a meeting room at Google and puts the link on the event. If the meeting is marked for automatic recording, the note about recording is written into the invitation too
aftalewindow.optag_som_webinar_kun_det_computeren_afs: Record as a webinar — only what the computer plays
aftalewindow.optagelsen_begynder_to_minutter_foer_det: The recording begins two minutes before. It requires HeyPia to be running — a program that is closed cannot start a recording. If the meeting moves, the recording moves with it.
aftalewindow.start_optagelsen_automatisk_naar_moedet_: Start the recording automatically when the meeting begins
aftalewindow.titel_tidspunkt_og_sted_sendes_op_moedet: Title, time and place are sent up. Meeting type, folder and language stay here — and audio, transcripts and notes are never sent.

transcribeview.den_gemmes_automatisk_ved_siden_af_optag: It is saved automatically next to the recording. You do not have to save anything yourself.
transcribeview.der_er_ikke_optaget_noget_endnu_tryk_opt: Nothing has been recorded yet. Press «Record meeting» or «Webinar» at the top.
transcribeview.du_kan_lukke_skaermen_skifte_til_en_ande: You can close the screen, switch to another tab — and you can record a new meeting while the previous one is being transcribed. Recording uses neither the graphics card nor any noticeable space, so it can never be blocked by this.
transcribeview.du_kan_roligt_lave_noget_andet_imens: You can safely do something else meanwhile
transcribeview.filen_bliver_liggende_i_mappen_den_blive: The file stays in the folder — it simply is not offered again
transcribeview.flyt_til_mappe_eller_traek_optagelsen_he: Move to folder — or drag the recording onto a folder in the tree
transcribeview.fold_foldere_ud_i_traeet_til_venstre_vae: Expand «Folders» in the tree on the left, select a recording, and press «Create transcript» at the top. Then the app writes out everything spoken as text you can read, search and correct.
transcribeview.fremdriften_staar_nederst_i_denne_rude_m: The progress is shown at the bottom of this pane. With a graphics card it runs faster than the audio lasts; without one it takes longer than the meeting itself.
transcribeview.indlaes_en_lydfil_udefra_eller_traek_den: Import an audio file from outside — or drag it into the list
transcribeview.laeg_hele_transkriptionen_i_udklipsholde: Put the whole transcript on the clipboard
transcribeview.lav_et_referat_eller_et_andet_dokument_u: Make minutes or another document out of the transcript
transcribeview.skriv_lyden_ud_til_tekst_her_paa_maskine: Transcribe the audio to text here on the machine
transcribeview.slet_lydfilerne_men_behold_transkription: Delete the audio files but keep the transcript
transcribeview.slet_optagelsen_med_lyd_og_transkription: Delete the recording with audio and transcript. Cannot be undone
transcribeview.tager_typisk_et_halvt_minut_foerste_gang: Usually takes half a minute the first time. Nothing happens on screen meanwhile — that is normal.
transcribeview.teksten_bliver_ikke_perfekt_navne_og_fag: The text will not be perfect. Names and technical terms are what most often come out wrong. You can correct it yourself: click into a line and type. The correction is stored separately, so what the machine heard is not lost — and it is the corrected text that documents and search use.
transcribeview.traek_en_optagelse_hen_paa_en_mappe_for_: Drag a recording onto a folder to move it.
transcribeview.vaelg_en_optagelse_i_traeet_og_skriv_den: Select a recording in the tree and transcribe it to text. It happens on this PC — no audio leaves the machine.
transcribeview.var_moedet_online_blev_der_optaget_to_sp: If the meeting was online, two tracks were recorded — your microphone and what the others said. Both are transcribed, so it takes about twice as long. In return both sides of the meeting are there, and each line shows which side was speaking.

udskriftview.cirka_et_halvt_minut_intet_forlader_mask: About half a minute. Nothing leaves the machine. Short — a few lines and at most four points. It does not write figures, and what it does write is checked against the transcript.
udskriftview.det_kan_godt_vaere_rigtigt_alligevel_ord: It may well be right anyway — the words can be phrased differently in the transcript than in the summary. But it has not been verified, and nothing has been deleted.
udskriftview.det_korte_navn_det_der_staar_paa_listen_: The short name — what appears in the list in the Cockpit
udskriftview.en_kort_opsummering_paa_ti_linjer_hvad_d: A short summary in ten lines: what was decided, what was agreed, and what was left open. To remember the meeting by — not a document you have to name and save.
udskriftview.et_rigtigt_moedereferat_en_opgaveliste_e: Real minutes, a task list or a proposal are made as a complete Word document by the language model you have set up in the cloud.
udskriftview.gennemgaa_transkriptionen_igen_for_stede: Go through the transcript again for places that could be a task
udskriftview.hele_opgaven_det_der_blev_sagt: The whole task — what was said
udskriftview.kopier_transkriptionen_med_eller_uden_ti: Copy the transcript — with or without timestamps and speakers
udskriftview.kun_denne_ene_replik_flyttes_de_oevrige_: Only this one line is moved. You do not touch the others.
udskriftview.maskinens_egne_ord_som_de_kom_ud_uden_di: The machine's own words, as they came out — without your corrections. It cannot be edited; it is there so it can be held up against the corrected one.
udskriftview.senest_dato_kan_staa_tom: Due date. May be left empty.
udskriftview.til_en_der_ikke_var_med_paa_moedet_det_k: For someone who was not at the meeting — the app cannot know that
udskriftview.tryk_opret_dokument_oeverst_til_hoejre_m: Press «Create document» at the top right. The meeting type from the recording is selected in advance — your meeting types are under «Meeting types» in the menu.
udskriftview.vis_kun_det_en_taler_sagde: Show only what one speaker said

documentsview.aabn_dokumentmappen_paa_disken: Open the document folder on disk
documentsview.beskrivelsen_staar_oeverst_i_selve_dokum: The description appears at the top of the document itself, not only here — so it travels with it when you pass it on.
documentsview.de_faerdige_tekster_gemt_som_word_dokume: The finished texts. Saved as Word documents (.docx).
documentsview.der_er_ikke_lavet_dokumenter_endnu_vaelg: No documents have been made yet. Select a recording under Recordings and press «Create document».
documentsview.det_gemmes_som_et_word_dokument_docx_vae: It is saved as a Word document (.docx). Select it in the tree, and you can open it, rename it or move it into a folder.
documentsview.flyt_til_mappe_eller_traek_dokumentet_he: Move to folder — or drag the document onto a folder in the tree
documentsview.gaa_til_optagelser_vaelg_en_optagelse_de: Go to «Recordings», select a recording that has been transcribed, and press «Create document». Then you confirm the meeting type — minutes, task list or whatever you have made yourself.
documentsview.gem_den_beskrivelse_du_har_skrevet_den_s: Save the description you have written. It appears at the top of the document itself
documentsview.laes_dokumentet_igennem_foer_du_sender_d: Read the document through before you pass it on. The model can get who said what wrong — especially if the names were never said out loud in the meeting — and it has previously added a participant who was not there.
documentsview.moedetypen_afgoer_hvilke_afsnit_dokument: The meeting type decides which sections the document gets, how long it becomes, and what must not appear in it. If it was chosen when the recording was started, it is selected in advance. The meeting types can be edited under «Meeting types».
documentsview.moedetypen_bestemmer_indholdet: The meeting type decides the content
documentsview.slet_dokumentet_kan_ikke_fortrydes: Delete the document. Cannot be undone
documentsview.teksten_sendes_til_sprogmodellen: The text is sent to the language model in the cloud
documentsview.til_forskel_fra_transkriptionen_sker_det: Unlike the transcription, this does not happen on the machine. The transcript is sent to the cloud API you have set up. The audio stays put. What that means for your particular supplier is explained under «Compliance».
documentsview.traek_et_dokument_hen_paa_en_mappe_for_a: Drag a document onto a folder to move it.
documentsview.transkriptionen_bliver_liggende_ved_opta: The transcript stays with the recording, and it can be used again. If the minutes did not come out as you wanted, you make a new set from the same transcript with a different meeting type — as many times as you like. The old document stays until you delete it yourself.
documentsview.vaelg_et_dokument_i_traeet_til_venstre_f: Select a document in the tree on the left to see it. New documents are made under «Recordings» — select a recording that has been transcribed, and press «Create document».

templatesview.0_0_holder_sig_taet_paa_transkriptionen_: 0.0 stays close to the transcript. Above 0.4 it phrases things freely — and for minutes that is a fault.
templatesview.aabn_mappen_med_moedetyper_paa_disken: Open the meeting types folder on disk
templatesview.dagsordenen_herunder_er_bygget_saa_moede: The agenda below is built so the meeting naturally covers what the meeting types look for: who is present, who says what, what is decided, what nobody can answer, and who follows up when. It is a suggestion — adapt it freely, but those five points are the ones that decide whether the transcript can become something usable.
templatesview.et_referat_kan_kun_indeholde_det_der_ble: Minutes can only contain what was said. If a name is never mentioned, a deadline never agreed or a decision never spoken out loud, it does not appear in the document either — however good the model is.
templatesview.gem_det_du_har_rettet_i_moedetypen: Save what you have changed in the meeting type
templatesview.hvilken_slags_moede_det_er_og_hvad_der_s: What kind of meeting it is — and what should come out of it
templatesview.instruktion_er_reglerne_hvad_modellen_sk: «Instruction» is the rules — what the model must do. This is the material it must do it on. Everything below is sent as it stands, apart from the fields, which are replaced with the meeting's own details.
templatesview.klik_paa_et_felt_for_at_saette_det_ind_i: Click a field to insert it into the text above. When the document is made, the field is replaced with the meeting's own details — {{transskription}} becomes the whole transcript.
templatesview.kopier_den_ind_i_moedeindkaldelsen_det_v: Copy it into the meeting invitation. The single most important point is the round of names: without it speaker recognition has no names to recognise, and then «who said what» becomes a guess.
templatesview.lad_mistral_skrive_en_dagsorden_der_pass: Let Mistral write an agenda that suits this particular meeting type
templatesview.laeg_hele_dagsordenen_i_udklipsholderen: Put the whole agenda on the clipboard
templatesview.loftet_over_svaret_cirka_3_tegn_pr_token: The ceiling on the answer. Roughly 3 characters per token.
templatesview.ny_moedetype_start_fra_en_tom_og_skriv_d: New meeting type — start from an empty one and write your own
templatesview.reglerne_for_hvem_der_kommer_paa_deltage: The rules for who ends up on the participant list are the same for every meeting type. Insert the field and they come along — change them in one place and every meeting type follows.
templatesview.reglerne_modellen_arbejder_efter_det_er_: The rules the model works by. This is where you decide what a set of minutes MUST and must not do — and this is where a fault in a set of minutes most often needs fixing.
templatesview.saet_et_felt_ind_hvor_markoeren_staar: Insert a field where the cursor is
templatesview.saetter_de_faelles_deltagerregler_ind_hv: Inserts the shared participant rules where the cursor is
templatesview.slet_den_valgte_moedetype_kan_ikke_fortr: Delete the selected meeting type. Cannot be undone

The only one of the three that does not run here on the machine — and it makes both the short summary and the finished documents: real minutes, a task list or whatever meeting types you have made.

It used to be possible to make the short summary on the machine. That option is gone as of 25 August 2026: it cost 4 GB to download and gave a shorter, thinner text. Without a key the app can therefore record and transcribe, but not summarise — and there is no summary without a connection.

The recording and the transcript stay on the machine; only the text is sent.

engineview.fire_modeller_goer_hver_sit_tre_af_dem_k: Three models each do their own job. Two of them run here on the machine — audio to text and speaker recognition. settingsview.lyden_er_det_eneste_i_appen_der_fylder_n: The audio is the only thing in the app that takes up any space. The text, your notes, the tasks and the documents together take up less than a single meeting does as audio.
settingsview.lyden_fylder_en_times_moede_med_to_spor_: Audio takes space. An hour-long meeting with two tracks is 220 MB, because the audio is stored uncompressed — that gives the best transcript. The text takes 56 KB, and the audio can be deleted once it has been transcribed.
settingsview.lyden_transkriptionerne_dine_noter_og_do: The audio, the transcripts, your notes and the documents never leave the machine this way. A calendar integration grants access to read a calendar.
settingsview.naar_en_optagelse_er_skrevet_ud_er_det_t: Once a recording has been transcribed, it is the text you use. The audio can be cleared after a while — then you keep the meeting without keeping the 220 MB.
settingsview.noejagtigheden_er_ikke_100_maalt_92_3_pa: The accuracy is not 100 %. Measured: 92.3 % in Danish, 90.5 % in English, 83.1 % when switching between languages mid-sentence. Names and technical terms are what most often come out wrong.

settingsview.teksten_i_moedeindkaldelsen: The text in the meeting invitation
settingsview.tre_ting_kan_kun_ske_mens_appen_er_aaben: Three things can only happen while the app is open: the shortcut key can start a recording, the meeting watch can ask when a program uses the microphone, and an event you have marked for automatic recording can start on its own.
settingsview.tryk_kombinationen_hvor_som_helst_i_wind: Press the combination anywhere in Windows and the recording begins straight away. Press «Choose shortcut» and type the combination you want — then it is the key you actually hit, not one that merely goes by the same name.
settingsview.uden_hak_bliver_filen_tilbudt_paa_optage: Without the tick the file is offered under Recordings, and you decide
settingsview.uden_nvidia_kort_koerer_udskriften_paa_p: Without an NVIDIA card the transcription runs on the processor. It works, but an hour-long meeting takes longer than the meeting itself lasted. Recording is unaffected.
settingsview.vaelg_et_arkiv_for_at_se_hvad_det_indeho: Select an archive to see what it contains.
settingsview.vaelg_mikrofon_og_hoejttaler_appen_lytte: Choose microphone and speaker. The app does not listen until you press test — or press record.
settingsview.udseende_forklaring: Light or dark. Follow Windows and the app changes when your machine does — including automatically in the evening, if you have set that up.
settingsview.eller_vaelg_fra_listen: Or pick from a list of combinations that are usually free
settingsview.diktering_intro: Speak, and there is text. Hold the shortcut key while you talk — let go, and it is written out and placed where you were working.
settingsview.diktering_til_under: Holding the shortcut key makes it a dictation instead of a meeting recording. A short press still starts a meeting, as before.
settingsview.diktering_til_pris: The cost is a moment: the app cannot know whether you are pressing or holding until you let go — so a meeting recording starts a third of a second later while dictation is on.
settingsview.diktering_lyd: Your own voice is sent to European AI when you dictate. Meeting audio never is — from there only the transcript is sent.
settingsview.diktering_loft_under: After that long the app stops by itself, and what you managed to say is written out. A message tells you to press again.
settingsview.diktering_loft_hvorfor: The limit exists because a key can stick. Without it the app would keep recording and sending until somebody noticed.
settingsview.diktering_formaal_under: The same speech becomes different text depending on what it is for. Can be changed from one time to the next.
settingsview.diktering_formaal_note: Note — close to what you said, just tidied up
settingsview.diktering_formaal_mail: Email — full text with an opening and a closing
settingsview.diktering_formaal_opgave: Task — one line in the imperative
settingsview.diktering_puds_under: Removes filler words and repetitions and adds punctuation. Switch it off and the text comes out verbatim — which is what you want when somebody is to be quoted.
settingsview.diktering_fagord_under: The word list has improved from the corrections you made yourself. Sent along, dictation knows those names and terms from the start.
settingsview.diktering_afbrudt: The dictation reached the limit and stopped. What you managed to say has been written out — press again to carry on.
settingsview.diktering_kraever_noegle: Dictation needs an API key for Mistral. Set it up under AI models.
settingsview.diktering_indsaet: Place the text where the cursor is
settingsview.diktering_indsaet_under: The text lands directly in the program you were working in. Switch it off and it goes to the clipboard for you to paste with Ctrl+V.
settingsview.diktering_indsaet_hvorfor: Focus is never taken. If you moved to another program while the text was being written out, it goes to the clipboard instead — it must not land in the middle of something else.
settingsview.diktering_efter_program: Choose the form from the program
settingsview.diktering_efter_program_under: In your mail it becomes an email. In an AI assistant it becomes a prompt. Only programs that can be recognised — otherwise your own choice is used.
settingsview.ordbog_under: Names, terms and abbreviations the transcription should know. The list is sent along with the audio as prior knowledge — and it corrects afterwards, when a word came back nearly right.
settingsview.ordbog_advarsel: The list leaves the machine with every dictation. That is why it is here, where you can see it — do not put anything in it that must not be sent.
settingsview.ordbog_nyt: New word — name, term or abbreviation
settingsview.ordbog_tom: The word library is empty. Add the names and terms that come back wrong.
settingsview.ordbog_antal: {0} words — the first {1} are sent along
settingsview.forloeb_under: Microphone, speaker, start with Windows, dictation and the wake word — gathered in one place, in the order they belong together. Useful on a new machine, with a new headset, or if something has drifted.
settingsview.forbrug_nu: What it is using right now
settingsview.forbrug_under: The app starts other programs: one writes out your meetings, one listens for the wake word. Each can take several gigabytes, and they run outside the app’s own window — in Task Manager they are not called HeyPia. Here they are gathered in one place.
settingsview.forbrug_hvordan: The figures are measured on the processes over two seconds, not estimated. 100 % means one processor core fully in use; on a machine with eight cores it can read more than 100 %, and that is not an error. It is the same calculation Task Manager uses, so the numbers can be compared.
settingsview.diktering_sprog_under: Sent with every dictation, so the model does not have to guess.
settingsview.diktering_sprog_hvorfor: If it guesses wrong, every single word is wrong — not just one. Measured 30-08-2026: «hallo, hallo, hallo» spoken in Danish came back as «Alors, alors, alors ?». French. It hits hardest what dictation is used for most: short sentences, where there is almost nothing to guess from.

complianceview.databehandleraftalen_gaelder_automatisk_: The data processing agreement applies automatically. It has to be neither ordered nor signed.
complianceview.den_her_gaar_begge_veje_i_modsaetning_ti: This one goes both ways — unlike the calendar.
complianceview.der_bedes_om_et_omraade_calendar_events_: ONE scope is requested: calendar.events. It is in the code and can be checked — and you see it on Google's own page before you approve.
complianceview.der_bedes_om_et_omraade_dine_opgaver_ikk: ONE scope is requested: your tasks. Not the calendar, not the mail, not the files.
complianceview.der_er_ikke_sendt_noget_endnu_foerste_ga: Nothing has been sent yet. The first time you make a document, the transmission appears here.
complianceview.derfor_betyder_det_noget_at_det_er_lyden: This is why it matters that it is the AUDIO that stays with you
complianceview.det_der_bliver_sendt_op_og_hvornaar: What gets sent up — and when
complianceview.det_der_kan_siges_og_som_holder_hele_vej: What can be said — and holds all the way
complianceview.det_der_kraever_praecision_i_formulering: WHAT REQUIRES PRECISION IN THE WORDING
complianceview.det_er_et_designvalg_ikke_en_begraensnin: It is a design choice, not a limitation waiting to be lifted. Speech recognition in the cloud would be faster, and it has been rejected. If transcription becomes too slow, the answer is better local models — not sending the audio away.
complianceview.det_er_ikke_en_overgangsloesning_appens_: This is not a stopgap. The app's own calendar is the real calendar, and it requires no account anywhere. An integration lays events on top; turn it off and the fetched ones disappear again, while your own remain.
complianceview.det_koster_et_login_mere_og_det_er_prise: It costs one more login, and it is worth the price: someone who only wants to share their calendar should not see «and your tasks» on Google's screen. A consent that covers more than what was asked for is not a consent.
complianceview.egen_godkendelse_adskilt_fra_kalenderen: Its own approval, separate from the calendar
complianceview.ejerskabet_er_den_anden_halvdel_microsof: Ownership is the other half: Microsoft, CoreWeave, Cloudflare, Kong, Sentry, Wiz and CrowdStrike are American-owned, even when the servers stand in the EEA. So «no American company is involved» cannot be said — whatever the endpoint.
complianceview.en_stemmeoptagelse_er_personoplysninger_: A voice recording is personal data. If it is processed for the purpose of recognising WHO is speaking, it is at the same time biometric data under Article 4(14) of the General Data Protection Regulation — and thereby a special category under Article 9, where the requirements are stricter. A recording is the raw material for that processing. A transcript is not: text cannot be turned back into a voiceprint.
complianceview.er_aftalen_markeret_til_at_blive_optaget: If the event is marked to be recorded, the invitation also states that meeting transcription is used, that it requires the AUDIO to be recorded, that no video is recorded, that the audio stays on your computer — and that anyone may object. The participants must have time to say no; that is the whole basis for recording a meeting with others present. The notice exists in Danish and English and follows the meeting's language. The wording can be edited under Settings, but not removed. If the event already has a description, it stays — the notice is added below it.
complianceview.filerne_er_almindelig_jsonl_en_linje_pr_: The files are ordinary JSONL — one line per transmission. They can be read by a spreadsheet or a script without the app
complianceview.forskellen_paa_en_lydfil_og_en_transkrip: The difference between an audio file and a transcript is not a matter of degree. They are two different kinds of information, and your meeting audio files never leave your machine. When you dictate, that one clip is sent — it is your own voice, and only while you hold the key down.
complianceview.fortael_altid_deltagerne_at_du_optager: Always tell the participants that you are recording.
complianceview.gaelder_automatisk_incorporated_to_the_a: Applies automatically — «incorporated to the Agreement by reference». It has to be neither ordered from sales nor signed separately.

complianceview.vaageord_hvad: The app can listen for a wake word so a dictation can be started without touching the keyboard. It is off until the user switches it on.
complianceview.vaageord_motor_under: whisper.cpp — the same program that writes out the meetings, already present on the machine. It listens using the SMALLEST of the downloaded models, not the one the meetings are written out with: hearing two words takes almost nothing, writing out an hour takes everything. In front of it sits a voice gate, Silero VAD, a 0.9 MB model, deciding whether anyone is speaking at all; recognition therefore runs only on speech and not on silence. Both are MIT-licensed and run locally. Nothing extra is downloaded to use the wake word.
complianceview.vaageord_intet_under: Nothing is sent while it listens — neither audio nor text. No file is stored: the app holds the last FOUR SECONDS of audio in memory, in a ring that continually overwrites itself, so what has fallen out exists nowhere. Those four seconds are there so the beginning of your sentence is not lost while the wake word is being decided. Only once the wake word HAS been heard does anything become a file — precisely the clip you spoke — and it is sent to be written out as in an ordinary dictation. No log of what was heard is kept.
complianceview.vaageord_hvornaar_under: When the screen is unlocked. If the machine is locked, it does not listen. If a recording is running — including an online meeting — listening stops until the recording ends. The consumption can be read on screen under Dictation → Commands, measured on the process itself.
complianceview.tastatur: THE SHORTCUT KEY — HOW IT IS READ
complianceview.tastatur_hvad: For a shortcut key to work while you are in another program, the app must be able to see that you press it. It does so with a keyboard watch in Windows — the same kind Windows itself, PowerToys and most shortcut programs use.
complianceview.tastatur_hvorfor: Why not Windows’ own shortcut registration
complianceview.tastatur_hvorfor_under: It was used until 30-08-2026 and did not work reliably. It is first-come-first-served, so another program may hold the key; it can succeed and still not work; and it translates the key before the app sees it — measured on a Danish machine, 669 presses of the numeric keypad comma arrived as «Delete», because Shift temporarily inverts NumLock. The shortcut therefore changed key by itself from day to day.
complianceview.tastatur_ser_under: Every keystroke passes by while the app runs. For each one, three things are read: where the key sat physically on the keyboard, whether it was a press or a release, and whether Ctrl, Shift or Alt was held down.
complianceview.tastatur_intet_under: No character is ever looked up. The app does not ask Windows which LETTER a key corresponds to — only where it sat. Nothing is written down: no file, no list, no log. One thing is remembered between two keystrokes, and that is whether your shortcut key is down right now. Everything else is passed on unchanged and forgotten the same instant. And nothing is sent anywhere — the reading happens solely on your own PC.
complianceview.tastatur_efterproev_under: The claim is in the code and can be read: the file is called Tastehook.cs. Under Settings → Machine requirements you can also measure what the app uses — a reading that wrote something down would cost both time and space.
